en: Black-and-white postcard view of a rural town in a valley surrounded by forested hills and a large mountain in the background. In the foreground are fields with cut hay drying on racks and a wooden structure of poles. A small town with smoking chimneys lies in the middle ground. White printed caption text at the bottom left reads "5-26-2 Tynset - mot Tronfjell." At the bottom right is a cursive publisher's mark and a number.
